crossRefs.note: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet…
and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he…
Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were…

people.name: Isaiah
people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

translations.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases.”
translations.bsb: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took up our infirmities and carried our diseases.”
translations.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
translations.asv: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: Himself took our infirmities, and bare our diseases.
